title: Signal and Archive
author: Odile Brightwater
blurb: Gideon Iversen, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
